turns.text: It's a nice gentle way to ask.
turns.zh: 这是一种很温和礼貌的问法。

turns.text: You can use it for so many things like would it be possible to get a coffee?
turns.zh: 这个说法可以用在很多地方，比如「可以来杯咖啡吗？」

turns.text: Or would it be possible to meet tomorrow?
But there are other ways to ask for a favor, too.
turns.zh: 不过请人帮忙还有别的方式。

turns.text: We can use other phrases that mean the same thing, just a little different.
turns.zh: 我们可以用其他意思一样的说法，只是稍微有点不同。

turns.text: Can you give us other ways, Liam?
turns.zh: Liam，你能再给我们举几个别的说法吗？
